headline: Lahore High Court Justice Mohsin Akhtar Kayani resigned on Wednesday, citing health concerns after a recent surgery and reasons of conscience, saying the 26th and 27th Constitutional Amendments compromised the independence of the high courts.

card.desc: Cites health and concerns over judicial independence.

caption:
Lahore High Court Justice Mohsin Akhtar Kayani resigned on Wednesday, citing health concerns after a recent surgery and reasons of conscience, Dawn reports. In his letter he said the 26th and 27th Constitutional Amendments compromised the independence of the high courts, Arab News adds.
